witness_description: No witness was found in the bounded search.
refutation_explanation: Every graph satisfying the quoted cross-set and same-set adjacency conditions was exactly the complete bipartite graph on that partition. This exhausts only the stated finite search space and does not establish an unbounded claim.
search_space: All 2,063,284 pairs consisting of a labeled simple undirected graph on n vertices and an ordered nonempty two-set partition, for each n from 2 through 6 inclusive.
